description:
The Shramik Parivahan Yojana is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of India to support the transportation needs of migrant workers. 

This scheme was initiated on 1st May 2020 in response to the challenges faced by migrant laborers during the COVID-19 pandemic. 

The primary objective of the Shramik Parivahan Yojana is to provide safe and affordable transportation for migrant workers who were stranded due to lockdown measures. 

The scheme aims to facilitate the movement of workers back to their home states. 

It also seeks to ensure that workers can return to their workplaces safely and efficiently. 

One of the measurable targets of the scheme is to provide transportation to at least 1 million workers within the first month of its launch. 

The scheme is designed to cover all states and union territories in India. 

The benefits of the Shramik Parivahan Yojana include free transportation for migrant workers. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹1,000 crores for the implementation of this scheme. 

Each worker is entitled to a free train ticket or a bus fare reimbursement. 

The scheme also provides for the transportation of their luggage. 

The eligibility criteria for the Shramik Parivahan Yojana include being a registered migrant worker. 

Workers must possess valid identification documents such as Aadhar cards or voter ID cards. 

There are no specific age limits for eligibility under this scheme. 

However, workers must be able to prove their employment status. 

The application process for the Shramik Parivahan Yojana is straightforward. 

Workers need to register through the official website or through designated state government offices. 

They must fill out an application form providing details such as name, age, and destination. 

Required documents include proof of identity and employment. 

Once the application is submitted, the state authorities will verify the details. 

Upon verification, workers will receive confirmation regarding their transportation arrangements. 

The timeline for the implementation of the scheme is ongoing. 

The government has set up a dedicated helpline for workers to inquire about transportation services. 

The helpline number is 1800 112 828. 

The frequency of transportation services is determined by demand and the availability of trains and buses. 

The Shramik Parivahan Yojana is implemented by the Ministry of Labour and Employment. 

State governments are also involved in the execution of the scheme. 

Local authorities coordinate the logistics of transportation. 

The scheme has been instrumental in facilitating the return of over 3 million migrant workers to their home states. 

Reports indicate that more than 4,000 trains were operated under this scheme in the initial months. 

The average cost of a train ticket for a migrant worker is approximately ₹800. 

The government has ensured that no worker is charged for the transportation services provided. 

The scheme has also been praised for its role in reducing the hardships faced by workers during the pandemic. 

In addition to transportation, the scheme has provisions for providing food and water to workers during their journey. 

The government has partnered with various NGOs to ensure that basic amenities are provided. 

The Shramik Parivahan Yojana is part of a larger initiative to support laborers in India. 

This initiative includes various other schemes aimed at improving the welfare of workers. 

The government has also launched awareness campaigns to inform workers about the scheme. 

These campaigns utilize social media and local media outlets to reach a wider audience. 

The success of the Shramik Parivahan Yojana has led to discussions about making it a permanent feature for migrant workers. 

The government is considering expanding the scope of the scheme to include more comprehensive support services. 

Feedback from workers has been largely positive regarding the implementation of the scheme. 

Many workers have expressed gratitude for the timely assistance provided. 

The Shramik Parivahan Yojana has also highlighted the importance of organized transportation for laborers. 

The scheme has underscored the need for better infrastructure to support migrant workers in the future. 

The government is continuously monitoring the effectiveness of the scheme. 

Data is being collected to assess the number of workers transported and their satisfaction levels. 

The Shramik Parivahan Yojana is a significant step towards ensuring the rights and welfare of migrant workers in India. 

It reflects the government's commitment to addressing the challenges faced by this vulnerable population. 

The scheme is expected to evolve based on the changing needs of workers. 

Future enhancements may include better tracking systems for transportation. 

The government aims to ensure that no worker is left behind during crises. 

Overall, the Shramik Parivahan Yojana represents a crucial intervention in the lives of millions of workers. 

It serves as a model for how government initiatives can adapt to meet urgent needs. 

The scheme is a testament to the resilience of India's labor force. 

It highlights the importance of solidarity and support during challenging times. 

The Shramik Parivahan Yojana is a vital component of India's social safety net for workers. 

It aims to create a more equitable and supportive environment for all laborers. 

The government continues to seek ways to improve and expand this initiative. 

The Shramik Parivahan Yojana stands as a beacon of hope for many migrant workers across the country. 

It is a reminder of the essential role that transportation plays in the lives of workers. 

The scheme has set a precedent for future welfare initiatives. 

It emphasizes the need for comprehensive planning and execution in addressing worker welfare.

It showcases the government's proactive approach in times of crisis. 

The scheme is a critical lifeline for many who depend on it for their livelihoods. 

It is an essential part of India's ongoing efforts to support its workforce.
